age.evidence: Subjects were age-matched (P50-60 on arrival) male and female Wistar rats

sex.evidence: age-matched (P50-60 on arrival) male and female Wistar rats

dosing.evidence: DOI was dissolved in sterile phosphate-buffered saline (PBS) at a concentration of 0.4 mg/ml for dosing at 0.4 mg/kg... administered in 1 mg/ml volumes by intraperitoneal injection 30-min prior to testing.

handling.evidence: Paper does not describe a handling habituation protocol.

group_housing.evidence: Animals were single-housed in a temperature and humidity-controlled environment

assays.assay_description: Operant chambers (Med-Associates) with two retractable levers; one delivering i.v. heroin (40 μg/50 μl infusion + light cue) and the other delivering oral alcohol (12%) or saccharin (0.1%) (75 μl bolus + tone cue). After FR1 and FR3 acquisition training, a series of progressive ratio tests measured break points for heroin vs. alcohol/saccharin under vehicle, DOI (0.4 mg/kg), MDL 100,907 (0.3 mg/kg), SB-242084 (0.5 mg/kg), and antagonist+DOI conditions. Latency to first lever press also measured.

application_type.evidence: DOI, MDL 100,907, and SB-242084 were administered in 1 mg/ml volumes by intraperitoneal injection 30-min prior to testing.

setup_habituation.evidence: Rats underwent FR1 and FR3 self-administration training in the same operant chambers prior to PR testing; no separate apparatus habituation without data collection is described.

setup_restrain.evidence: Rats were placed in the operant chambers for testing; no restraint described.

food_restriction.evidence: Operant chamber equipped only with a liquid delivery port for alcohol/saccharin; standard laboratory chow available in home cage but not in the testing chamber.

water_restriction.evidence: free access to standard laboratory chow and water [in home cage]; no water bottle in the operant chamber.

time_to_assay.evidence: All injections were administered 30 min prior to placement in the operant chambers for testing.

sample_size.evidence: MDL experiment: n = 7 vehicle; n = 8 DOI (alcohol group); n = 7 vehicle; n = 8 DOI (saccharin group). SB experiment: n = 7 vehicle; n = 7 DOI.

outcomes.summary: Acute 0.4 mg/kg DOI (i.p., 30 min pre-test) significantly reduced heroin break points but did not affect alcohol or saccharin break points in rats with a history of heroin+alcohol or heroin+saccharin co-self-administration. The 5-HT2A antagonist MDL 100,907 (0.3 mg/kg) blocked DOI's effect on heroin motivation, while the 5-HT2C antagonist SB-242084 (0.5 mg/kg) did not. DOI did not alter latency to the first lever press, ruling out nonspecific motoric/attentional impairment. Neither antagonist altered break points on its own.
outcomes.statistics: MDL experiment DOI: main effect F(1,13)=8.67, p=0.011; reward x treatment F(1,13)=5.68, p=0.033; vehicle vs. DOI heroin p=0.002. SB experiment DOI: main effect F(1,12)=4.609, p=0.053; reward x treatment F(1,12)=5.41, p=0.038; vehicle vs. DOI p=0.010. Saccharin controls MDL: F(1,13)=17.88, p=0.001; SB: F(1,13)=5.18, p=0.040; reward x treatment F(1,13)=6.95, p=0.021. SB+DOI in alcohol group: reward x treatment F(1,12)=4.31, p=0.060; saccharin controls main effect F(1,12)=5.17, p=0.042; reward x treatment F(1,12)=6.02, p=0.030.
outcomes.evidence: DOI significantly reduced heroin (vehicle vs. DOI: p = 0.002), but not alcohol, break points in the MDL experiment... Post-hoc analyses indicated DOI reduced heroin (vehicle vs. DOI; p = 0.010), but not alcohol, break points

B1_num_measures.evidence: Break points (for heroin and alcohol/saccharin) and latency to the first lever press were reported.

B2_temporal_dynamics.evidence: Only summary break point per session reported; no within-session time-course analysis.

B3_sequential_structure.evidence: No analysis of behavioural transitions or sequences.

B4_ethological.evidence: Operant lever pressing is not an ethological behaviour.

B5_social.evidence: Rats tested alone in operant chambers.

B6_cognitive.evidence: Progressive ratio task with learned operant responding for heroin and alcohol/saccharin rewards.

B8_multivariate.evidence: Break points were analyzed using two-way or three-way repeated measures ANOVA; no dimensionality reduction.

E1_environment_type.evidence: rat self-administration chambers enclosed within sound attenuating cubicles (Med-Associates)

E3_bedding.evidence: Standard operant chamber floor; no bedding described.

E5_enrichment.evidence: No enrichment objects in the operant chamber.

E6_spatial.evidence: Standard operant chamber with two levers and a liquid delivery port within a single arena; no separate compartments.

E7_social_context.evidence: Focal rat tested alone in the operant chamber.

E8_food_water.evidence: Each press on the lever delivered a single bolus of alcohol or saccharin (75 μl) into the delivery port; heroin lever delivered i.v. infusion. Liquid reward (saccharin/alcohol containing water) is accessible during the PR session.

D1_continuity.evidence: A sequence of progressive ratio tests was conducted (baseline drug-free, antagonist alone, DOI alone, drug-free, antagonist+DOI, follow-up drug-free), separated by at least three days.

D2_session_duration.evidence: daily self-administration training (FR1; 3h/session/weekday)... alcohol/saccharin phase lasted 30 min, followed by heroin phase that lasted 2.5 h. PR tests conducted in the same operant chambers.

D3_recording_days.evidence: At least 6 PR tests were conducted (baseline, antagonist alone, DOI alone, drug-free interim, antagonist+DOI, follow-up drug-free), separated by ≥3 days.

D4_baseline.evidence: The first progressive ratio test in each experiment was conducted drug-free to assess the baseline motivation

D5_followup.evidence: A drug-free progressive ratio test was conducted one (SB experiment) to seven (MDL experiment) days after this test as well to screen for lasting DOI effects

D6_circadian.evidence: Sessions ~3 h total; no single session ≥6 h.

judge_notes: All candidates identified a single behavioural paradigm (progressive ratio operant test); merged into one assay even though it was run under multiple drug/antagonist conditions, per rubric.
D2 scored 2 (61 min–6 h): training/test sessions used the same chambers and protocol gives 30 min alcohol phase + 2.5 h heroin phase = ~3 h session length (gptoss missed this; glm captured it).
E8 scored 1 (Yes): liquid reward (alcohol/saccharin) is accessible during the PR session via the delivery port, even though chow/water bottle are not in the chamber.
B1 scored 1 (2-3): break point + latency to first press = 2 measures (qwen's '1' point was incorrect categorization; correct mapping for 2-3 measures = 1 point).
E6 scored 0 (Single open space): a standard operant chamber with two levers is one arena without dividers/walls; glm's '1' was overcalled.

setup_habituation set to 'no' given extensive prior training in the same chambers serves as functional familiarization but no separate pre-test habituation phase is described; this is borderline and marked medium confidence.
